verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost identical, and both share the same flaws. The 'SOLSTICE TASTING TEAM' credit has moved above the quote, which breaks the reading order. That credit and the can label are too small to read at this size. The logo floats loose between the quote and the can, and there is dead space under the circle and between the quote mark and the credit. B wins only because its logo is a little larger and easier to read, while A's logo and sun icon are tiny enough to almost disappear.
